roles.mission: Turns the brief into a contract: audience, platform, length, tone, acceptance criteria; picks one option from the menu with the user; owns the final call.
roles.gate: A written brief with acceptance criteria before any render.

roles.mission: Measures the uploaded audio/video: duration, streams, fps, loudness, energy cues, scene cuts, words (when an aligned transcript exists). Never guesses meaning or tempo.
Script beats, on-screen text and Arabic captions in natural Arabic; never splits joined Arabic letters.
roles.gate: Every on-screen word traced to the user's audio or approved script.

roles.mission: IDM-style acquisition: segmented resumable downloads with SHA-256, stream grabbing via yt-dlp/ffmpeg, licensed stock search, and a rights manifest for every clip. Refuses DRM bypass and unlicensed use.
roles.gate: rights.json entry (source page, licence, sha256) for every external file.

roles.mission: Converts every input to an edit-friendly mezzanine (CFR, H.264/AAC 48 kHz) and light proxies — the role IDM's video converter plays, done with ffmpeg.
roles.gate: All clips share fps, pixel format and audio rate.

roles.mission: Cut plan on measured cuts and energy, beat/word-synced edits, reframes for each platform, transitions with purpose.
roles.gate: Contiguous EDL, no gaps, no cut inside a word.

roles.mission: Kinetic typography, draw-on, camera moves, easing and glow as real time-based animation (seek(t)), never static slides.
roles.gate: Deterministic scene: window.__kosif.seek(t) renders the same frame twice.

roles.mission: Original characters, IK gestures, walk/wave/blink cycles and stroke draw-on.
Real 3D only when the camera must move around objects: native renderer, GLB export, Blender bridge when installed.
roles.gate: Frames rendered and counted; no Blender claim without Blender.

roles.mission: Keeps the user's master audio untouched; builds a delivery mix (ducking, -14 LUFS) as a separate file only when asked.
roles.gate: Master audio hash unchanged; delivery loudness measured.

roles.mission: Looks via ffmpeg/OpenCV: grade, contrast, grain, vignette, LUTs; matches a reference palette when given.
Preview first, then final render (Chromium/Playwright for HTML scenes, ffmpeg, Remotion when installed).
roles.gate: Preview approved before the final render.

roles.mission: verify_video.py on every output, frame contact sheet, honest report of what was and was not checked.
roles.gate: TEST_REPORT values filled from real measurements.
